expo.name: NIMO
expo.description: NIMO — Create. Transform. Shine. Turn your photos into stunning portraits, videos and more with AI.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NIMO uses the camera so you can take a selfie to create stylish AI portraits.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NIMO needs access to your photos to transform your portrait using AI templates.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: NIMO saves your generated high-definition portraits to your photo library.
